notShown: Client sites: their jobs are recorded only in their own repos, never here (your rule).
Time-2-Read voice costs are no longer a weekly report: you hear about them only if the paid voice runs low on credits or a child gets switched to the browser voice.
Creator studio emails to you are cancelled, including P&P Studio. Sign-in codes still come.
about: Every scheduled job across her systems, in Central time: Boss OS duties, the Mac's launchd jobs, GitHub Actions and Cloudflare crons in her repos, and West Peek OS's jobs. Client repos are never listed (clientRepoProblems). The Schedule page renders this and nothing else; tests/schedule.test.ts and npm run schedule:check hold it to the real triggers.
